description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans serialization support of the .NET ISerializable interface, including tests for objects and structs with serialization callbacks, exception serialization, and custom type resolution.

classes.name: SimpleISerializableObject
classes.description: A serializable class implementing ISerializable and IDeserializationCallback, with serialization callbacks and history tracking.

classes.name: SimpleISerializableStruct
classes.description: A serializable struct implementing ISerializable and IDeserializationCallback, with serialization callbacks and history tracking.

classes.name: UnserializableConformingException
classes.description: A custom exception class that supports serialization, inheriting from BaseException.

classes.name: UnserializableNonConformingException
classes.description: An exception class that does not support serialization, inheriting directly from Exception.

classes.name: BaseException
classes.description: A base class for custom exceptions supporting serialization and containing a serializable property.

classes.name: BanningTypeResolver
classes.description: A custom type resolver that blocks specific types from being resolved.

methods.name: SerializationLoop
methods.description: Performs serialization and deserialization of an object using Orleans serialization, verifying consistency.
